notes.title: Chronicle of the Crusade #1: Abominations
notes.content: [p]We are finally ready to start lifting the veil on Band of Crusaders, sharing how the world, its enemies, and its systems take shape. To open things up, we are focusing on one of the first horrors you will face: the Abominations. These creatures are the spawn of Chaos itself, and among their ranks lurks one of our earliest designs, the Hellhound.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Origins of the Abominations[/b][/h3][hr][/hr][p]The year is 1350. Europe has been burning for decades. Villages are reduced to ash, kingdoms are shattered, and the land itself feels poisoned. From this devastation emerge the Abominations. They are not visitors from some faraway realm, but twisted growths born on our own earth.[/p][p]Chaos is not a single demon with a crown. It is a creeping current of corruption, an invisible tide that warps everything it touches into something foul and unnatural.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Design approach[/b][/h3][hr][/hr][p]Abominations are our way of exploring grotesque design to its limits. They are bodies patched together from human remains, animal carcasses, and even pieces of the natural world such as roots or rotting plants. The goal is for them to shock the eye while still feeling plausible, as though they could have clawed their way up from medieval soil.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145831/18a114f92e9e76d5fa7a47098603012da378f0b0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]When creating them, we often follow two paths.[/p][list][*][p]One is to build directly from [b]the world of medieval Europe[/b] itself: its animals, its forests, and its people. Wolves that bleed into men, trees knotted into bone, soil hardened into a jagged shell.[/p][/*][*][p]The other is to draw from[b] old myths and symbols[/b], inspired by medieval manuscripts and biblical visions. The idea is not to copy them literally, but to borrow the sense of the eerie and the symbolic that once defined how people imagined demons.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145831/38a43c23a5f312a42dd6e346357ae3bc22fa221b.jpg"][/img]  [/p][p]The most important thing is that these creatures do not feel like aliens. They carry no relics, they wear no enchanted armor. They corrupt and reshape whatever matter they find, creating animalistic hybrids that seem as much curse as predator. Some characters in the game will swear they are divine punishments for humanity’s sins. Others believe they are something even darker.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Hellhound: a prime Abomination example[/b][/h3][hr][/hr][p]Hellhounds are one of the earliest Abominations you will meet.[/p][p]It moves on four legs and immediately recalls a dog or a wolf. Was it once a knight’s mastiff, a wild wolf from the forest, or a poor farm dog caught in Chaos? Whatever its origin, its body is now a ruin of sinew and bone. Its jaw is still canine, but antlers jut from its skull like a stag’s crown. Parasitic limbs sprout from its back, grotesque echoes of the twisted appendages grown by cultist heretics. In the hound they are far more developed. This is not an accident.[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145831/80c438473b504b84f80d9a21a34eb392518b9761.gif"][/img][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Special traits[/b][/h3][hr][/hr][p]Even at its lowest level the Hellhound has its own deadly tricks.[/p][list][*][p][b]Blooddrinker[/b]: every bite restores its health, making it more difficult to put down than you expect. This leeching ability is common among Abominations, reflecting their parasitic will to survive.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Feast[/b]: when close to death, the Hellhound may run away and devour corpses nearby, regaining strength only to return to the fight. Players must decide whether to chase it before it heals or focus on the rest of the pack.[/p][/*][/list][p]These traits make the Hellhound more than cannon fodder. Each one is a piece of the larger combat puzzle that defines the game.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]The many faces of the Hellhound[/b][/h3][hr][/hr][p]The Hellhound does not always appear in the same form. Variants exist that will change the rhythm of the fight and test new tactics. Bringing one down is no small feat, but survivors are rewarded. The trophies carved from its corpse carry real value in denars, and traders will pay well for them.[/p]

notes.title: ⚔️ New Gameplay Trailer is Here! ⚔️
notes.content: [p]Crusaders,[/p][p][/p][p]the latest trailer for Band of Crusaders has arrived! In the past few months, we’ve worked hard, and now we’re proud to reveal a brand-new video footage showcasing some of the new gameplay.[/p][p]🔥 More action[/p][p]👹 More abominations[/p][p]⚔️ More reasons to join the crusade[/p][p]This is just a glimpse of what’s to come. notes.title: ⚔️ Band of Crusaders is Preparing for Kickstarter🤝
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, Crusaders![/p][p][/p][p]We’re excited to announce that [i][b]Band of Crusaders[/b][/i][b] is preparing for a Kickstarter campaign[/b]. This decision may come as a surprise to some of you, since the game already has a thriving community and the backing of NCSOFT as its publisher. After serious discussions within the team, we concluded that Kickstarter is the perfect way to further expand our community and open ourselves up to even more discussion and scrutiny beyond our current channels.[/p][p][/p][p]We believe this will ultimately help us deliver the quality, depth, and experience our community deserves. With your support, we can make Band of Crusaders a truly special game.[/p][p][/p][p]Our Kickstarter page is now live — follow it today to be notified the moment we launch! We’re also preparing some exclusives for early supporters, so you won’t want to miss out. Early momentum is key in helping Band of Crusaders reach as many players as possible.[/p][p][/p][p][b]🔗 Follow the Kickstarter page here: [/b][/p][p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/virtualalchemy/band-of-crusaders"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/virtualalchemy/band-of-crusaders[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for being part of this journey. We can’t wait to share more with you soon — onward to battle! 🛡️⚔️[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Playtest Recap & What’s Ahead
notes.content:
[h3][b]We ran the community playtest between June 5th and June 15th — the very first playtest of [i]Band of Crusaders[/i] — and we are beyond thrilled to share some highlights with you![/b][/h3][p]Despite this being our very first public test, we made the adventurous decision to open access to content creators. They were not only able to preview the game, but also stream, record, and publish videos about [i]Band of Crusaders[/i]. [b]This creator-focused phase ended on July 6th[/b], so it’s high time for a proper summary.[/p][p][/p][h3][u]First off, a huge thank you to everyone who participated:[/u][/h3][p]To our incredible community playtesters — thank you for sharing your first look at a playable version of the game. You’re all awesome![/p][p]While [i]Band of Crusaders[/i] is a game that fulfills our own creative fantasies (we're building it for ourselves, in a sense), we’re equally building it for you — and this playtest has shown we can build it with you.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145831/ab94e565781a6858f19de0a3b44701b074802ad6.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][u]By the numbers:[/u][/h3][p]●     Over 150 participants joined the playtest
●     According to Steam, players spent a median of 1.5 hours playing
●     Some players exceeded 5 or even 10 hours — a huge milestone for us![/p][p][/p][h3][u]Community engagement:[/u][/h3][p]During the playtest, we released 4 patches, addressing stability and UX issues. And speaking of improvements — the feedback was tremendous. We received over 500 pieces of feedback through:[/p][p]●     The BoC Playtest Discord
●     The dedicated feedback questionnaire
●     Social media comments
●     A fantastic written essay compiled by mdval_de and his[url="https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2484156690"] Twitch community[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145831/a1849eaa519c0c2c278192621a451afa2b0a3ed5.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][u]Key insights:[/u][/h3][p]You expressed that the Campaign Map and Combat are equally important priorities for the next development phase.[/p][p]●     On the Campaign Map side, many suggestions revolved around features we already plan to add — particularly world simulation and player influence.
●     For Combat, we noticed the need for better onboarding and tutorials, and you often asked for more varied combat encounters and overall deeper tactical gameplay.
[/p][p]We’re now focusing on fixing some remaining bugs and synthesizing your feedback with our dev and publishing teams. And yes — we also noticed your encouraging words and praise for specific aspects of the game, even at this early stage. That means the world to us![/p][p]After 3.5 years of development, we still see so many missing pieces and imperfections — but your support recharges our motivation.[/p][p][/p][h3][u]Some interesting highlights from the playtest:[/u][/h3][p]●     Most active member in the playtest channels: Danny Benny 😎
●     Most watched video:[url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fqu60KOaDRs"] Jackie Fish
[/url]●     Most concurrent viewers on a stream:[url="https://www.twitch.tv/writing_bull"] Writing Bull
[/url]●     Most “ambassadorship-y” streamer:[url="https://www.twitch.tv/mratomicduck"] Mr AtomicDuck[/url][/p][p][url="https://www.twitch.tv/mratomicduck"]
[/url][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145831/78ede8d78cd4de013a4b11a173e030da4b32bfcd.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]We’re extremely grateful for all the communication, feedback, and effort from our community. Rest assured: your input is shaping [i]Band of Crusaders[/i] into the best game it can possibly be.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]That’s it for now. We can’t wait to deliver an even stronger experience next time you return to [i]Band of Crusaders[/i]![/p]

notes.title: Band of Crusaders partners up with NCSOFT
notes.content:
Dear community!

We’ve got some big news to share - [b]Band of Crusaders is teaming up with NCSOFT as our global publisher[/b]! For us as developers, this is a dream come true - NCSOFT’s support gives us the chance to craft something really special for you.

We owe so much to you, our community. Your wishlists, your feedback, and every bit of engagement have been our lifeline - especially in these tough times for indie devs. Knowing you’ve got our back has kept us pushing forward. Now, with NCSOFT in our corner, we’re more pumped than ever to deliver on our vision for Band of Crusaders.

There’s some exciting stuff brewing and can’t wait to share with you soon!

Cheers,
Dominik

notes.title: Thank You!
notes.content:
[b]To Our Amazing Community,[/b]

We’re thrilled to announce that [i]Band of Crusaders[/i] has reached an incredible milestone: [b]30,000 wishlists![/b] This is a moment of celebration for all of us, and we couldn’t have done it without your incredible support.
We want to take this opportunity to say a heartfelt [b]THANK YOU[/b] for your enthusiasm, trust and for engaging with us on Discord, the Steam forum and other social media platforms. Your passion fuels our determination to work even harder to deliver the best game possible.

As we continue our journey, we’re preparing some exciting updates to share with you in the near future. Stay tuned - it’s going to be worth the wait!
Once again, thank you for being part of this adventure with us. We can’t wait to bring you more updates as we progress!

[b]With warmest regards,[/b]
Dominik (on behalf of the Band of Crusaders team)
